name: TallyFlow
overview: AI-powered financial reconciliation platform for investigating invoices, payments, and ledger discrepancies.
problem: Small businesses and creators spend dozens of hours each month manually matching bank statements against invoices and receivables.
solution: TallyFlow combines intelligent investigation, deterministic matching, and human approval to resolve financial discrepancies.
architecture: FastAPI Python backend handling high-precision financial arithmetic and database migrations with PostgreSQL, accompanied by a React & TypeScript frontend.
features: Automated bank feed ingestion and invoice matching
Exportable financial reports in PDF and spreadsheet formats
Role-based access control for accountants and auditors

design_decisions.reason: Provides asynchronous high-throughput execution with strict Pydantic data validation for sensitive monetary amounts.
Avoids floating point rounding errors critical in financial accounting systems.

challenges.challenge: Handling mismatched date formats and currency strings from diverse banking exports
challenges.solution: Created an extensible parser pipeline that normalizes various CSV and JSON bank schemas into a unified transaction structure.

contributions: Lead Engineer — developed the reconciliation parser in FastAPI and the interactive data visualization dashboard.
additional_context: TallyFlow is an AI-powered financial reconciliation platform that investigates invoice, payment, and ledger discrepancies using intelligent investigation, deterministic matching, and human approval.
